data: WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation {m : ℕ} (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) : Prop
WeakSimplex.Coord (m : ℕ) : Type
WeakSimplex.lowerOrthant {m : ℕ} (c : ℝ) : Set (WeakSimplex.Coord m)
WeakSimplex.measurableSet_lowerOrthant {m : ℕ} (c : ℝ) : MeasurableSet (WeakSimplex.lowerOrthant c)
WeakSimplex.regularSimplexGram (m : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ

WeakSimplex.gramNormalization {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) (G : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) :
  WeakSimplex.IsWeakSimplexCov (((↑m - 1) / ↑m) • G + (1 / ↑m) • WeakSimplex.allOnesMatrix m) ∧
    WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation (WeakSimplex.regularSimplexGram m) ∧
      ((↑m - 1) / ↑m) • WeakSimplex.regularSimplexGram m + (1 / ↑m) • WeakSimplex.allOnesMatrix m = 1

WeakSimplex.map_codeScore_stdGaussian {m n : ℕ} (code : Fin m → WeakSimplex.Coord n) :
  MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun y => WeakSimplex.Coord.ofFun fun i => inner ℝ (code i) y)
      (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian (WeakSimplex.Coord n)) =
    ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (WeakSimplex.codeGram code)
WeakSimplex.normalPDF_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < WeakSimplex.normalPDF x
WeakSimplex.hasDerivAt_normalPDF (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt WeakSimplex.normalPDF (-x * WeakSimplex.normalPDF x) x
WeakSimplex.hasDerivAt_normalCDF (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt WeakSimplex.normalCDF (WeakSimplex.normalPDF x) x

WeakSimplex.truncated_second_moment (s : ℝ) :
  ∫ (x : ℝ) in Set.Iic s, x ^ 2 * WeakSimplex.normalPDF x = WeakSimplex.normalCDF s - s * WeakSimplex.normalPDF s

WeakSimplex.isLogConcave_lintegral_right.{u, v} {E : Type u} {ι : Type v} [AddCommMonoid E] [Module ℝ E] [Fintype ι]
  {F : E → (ι → ℝ) → ENNReal} (hF_meas : ∀ (x : E), Measurable (F x))
  (hF_lc : WeakSimplex.IsLogConcave fun p => F p.1 p.2) : WeakSimplex.IsLogConcave fun x => ∫⁻ (y : ι → ℝ), F x y

WeakSimplex.measurable_isLogConcave_lintegral_right.{u, v} {E : Type u} {ι : Type v} [MeasurableSpace E]
  [AddCommMonoid E] [Module ℝ E] [Fintype ι] {F : E → (ι → ℝ) → ENNReal} (hF_meas : Measurable (Function.uncurry F))
  (hF_lc : WeakSimplex.IsLogConcave fun p => F p.1 p.2) :
  (Measurable fun x => ∫⁻ (y : ι → ℝ), F x y) ∧ WeakSimplex.IsLogConcave fun x => ∫⁻ (y : ι → ℝ), F x y

WeakSimplex.map_gaussianRegularization_eq_multivariateGaussian {m : ℕ} (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
  (hR : R.PosSemidef) (ε : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 ≤ ε) (hε₁ : ε ≤ 1) :
  MeasureTheory.Measure.map (WeakSimplex.gaussianRegularizationMap ε)
      ((ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 R).prod (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian (WeakSimplex.Coord m))) =
    ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 ((1 - ε) • R + ε • 1)

WeakSimplex.tendstoInDistribution_regularized_multivariateGaussian {m : ℕ} (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
  (hR : R.PosSemidef) :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution (fun x => id) Filter.atTop id
    (fun n => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 ((1 - (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1)) • R + (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1) • 1))
    (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 R)

ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian_of_not_posSemidef.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  (μ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) {S : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hS : ¬S.PosSemidef) :

ProbabilityTheory.measurePreserving_eval_multivariateGaussian.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_of_tendsto_charFun.{u_1} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]

MeasureTheory.Measure.integral_comp_smul.{u_1, u_2} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
  {F : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : E → F) (R : ℝ) :
  ∫ (x : E), f (R • x) ∂μ = |(R ^ Module.finrank ℝ E)⁻¹| • ∫ (x : E), f x ∂μ

hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {α : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace α]
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {𝕜 : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] {E : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {bound : α → ℝ} {F : 𝕜 → α → E} {x₀ : 𝕜} {s : Set 𝕜} (hs : s ∈ nhds x₀)
  (hF_meas : ∀ᶠ (x : 𝕜) in nhds x₀, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F x) μ)
  (hF_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (F x₀) μ) {F' : 𝕜 → α → E}
  (hF'_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' x₀) μ) (h_bound : ∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ s, ‖F' x a‖ ≤ bound a)
  (bound_integrable : MeasureTheory.Integrable bound μ)
  (h_diff : ∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ s, HasDerivAt (fun x => F x a) (F' x a) x) :
  MeasureTheory.Integrable (F' x₀) μ ∧ HasDerivAt (fun n => ∫ (a : α), F n a ∂μ) (∫ (a : α), F' x₀ a ∂μ) x₀

Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁.{u_1, u_2, u_4} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {R' : Type u_4} [CommRing R'] [PartialOrder R']
  [StarRing R'] [Fintype m] [StarOrderedRing R'] [Finite n] [DecidableEq m] {A : Matrix m m R'} (B : Matrix m n R')
  (D : Matrix n n R') (hA : A.PosDef) [Invertible A] :
  (Matrix.fromBlocks A B B.conjTranspose D).PosSemidef ↔ (D - B.conjTranspose * A⁻¹ * B).PosSemidef

theorem FSCProbes.Imports.gram_lowerOrthant : ∀ {m d : ℕ} (code : Fin m → Coord d) (t : ℝ),
  (multivariateGaussian 0 (codeGram code)) (lowerOrthant t) =
    (stdGaussian (Coord d)) {y | ∀ (i : Fin m), ⟪code i, y⟫_ℝ ≤ t} :=
fun {m d} code t =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a => _a (lowerOrthant t) = (stdGaussian (Coord d)) {y | ∀ (i : Fin m), ⟪code i, y⟫_ℝ ≤ t})
        (Eq.symm (map_codeScore_stdGaussian code))))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (stdGaussian (Coord d)) {y | ∀ (i : Fin m), ⟪code i, y⟫_ℝ ≤ t})
          (Measure.map_apply
            (id
              (Measurable.fun_comp (WithLp.measurable_toLp 2 (Fin m → ℝ))
                (measurable_pi_lambda (fun y i => ⟪code i, y⟫_ℝ) fun a =>
                  Continuous.measurable (Continuous.inner continuous_const continuous_id'))))
            (measurableSet_lowerOrthant t))))
      (Eq.refl ((stdGaussian (Coord d)) ((fun y => Coord.ofFun fun i => ⟪code i, y⟫_ℝ) ⁻¹' lowerOrthant t))))

theorem FSCProbes.Imports.joint_linear_image_factorization : ∀ {d m k : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  (A : Coord d →L[ℝ] Fin m → ℝ) (B : Coord d →L[ℝ] Fin k → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin m) (j : Fin k), cov[fun x => A x i, fun x => B x j; multivariateGaussian 0 G] = 0) →
    Measure.map (fun x => (A x, B x)) (multivariateGaussian 0 G) =
      (Measure.map (⇑A) (multivariateGaussian 0 G)).prod (Measure.map (⇑B) (multivariateGaussian 0 G)) :=
fun {d m k} G A B hcross =>
  have hjoint := HasGaussianLaw.map IsGaussian.hasGaussianLaw_id (A.prod B);
  have hindep := HasGaussianLaw.indepFun_of_covariance_eval hjoint hcross;
  IndepFun.map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (Measurable.aemeasurable (ContinuousLinearMap.measurable A))
    (Measurable.aemeasurable (ContinuousLinearMap.measurable B)) hindep

theorem FSCProbes.Imports.affine_image_isGaussian : ∀ {d m : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  (A : Coord d →L[ℝ] Coord m) (b : Coord m), IsGaussian (Measure.map (fun x => A x + b) (multivariateGaussian 0 G)) :=
fun {d m} G A b =>
  have hmap :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Measure.map (fun x => A x + b) (multivariateGaussian 0 G))
          (Measure.map_map (Measurable.add_const measurable_id' b) (ContinuousLinearMap.measurable A))))
      (Eq.refl (Measure.map ((fun y => y + b) ∘ ⇑A) (multivariateGaussian 0 G)));
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => IsGaussian _a) (Eq.symm hmap))) inferInstance

theorem FSCProbes.Imports.convex_support_marginal : ∀ {m d : ℕ} (s : Set ((Fin m → ℝ) × (Fin d → ℝ))),
  MeasurableSet s →
    Convex ℝ s →
      (Measurable fun r => ∫⁻ (y : Fin d → ℝ), convexIndicator s (r, y)) ∧
        IsLogConcave fun r => ∫⁻ (y : Fin d → ℝ), convexIndicator s (r, y) :=
fun {m d} s hs hc =>
  measurable_isLogConcave_lintegral_right (measurable_convexIndicator hs) (isLogConcave_convexIndicator hc)

theorem FSCProbes.Imports.schur_complement_posSemidef : ∀ {m d : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
  (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin d) ℝ) (D : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ),
  A.PosDef →
    ∀ [Invertible A],
      (Matrix.fromBlocks A B B.conjTranspose D).PosSemidef → (D - B.conjTranspose * A⁻¹ * B).PosSemidef :=
fun {m d} A B D hA [Invertible A] hblock => (Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₁₁ B D hA).mp hblock

theorem FSCProbes.Imports.haar_scaling : ∀ {d : ℕ} (f : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (r : ℝ),
  ∫ (x : Fin d → ℝ), f (r • x) = |(r ^ d)⁻¹| * ∫ (x : Fin d → ℝ), f x :=
fun {d} f r =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (Eq (∫ (x : Fin d → ℝ), f (r • x)))
        (congrFun' (congrArg HMul.hMul (Eq.trans (abs_inv (r ^ d)) (congrArg Inv.inv (abs_pow r d))))
          (∫ (x : Fin d → ℝ), f x))))
    (Eq.mp
      (congrArg (Eq (∫ (x : Fin d → ℝ), f (r • x)))
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg HSMul.hSMul
            (Eq.trans
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg abs
                  (congrArg Inv.inv
                    (congrArg (HPow.hPow r) (Eq.trans (Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card ℝ) (Fintype.card_fin d)))))
                (abs_inv (r ^ d)))
              (congrArg Inv.inv (abs_pow r d))))
          (∫ (x : Fin d → ℝ), f x)))
      (Measure.integral_comp_smul ℙ f r))

theorem FSCProbes.Imports.hasDerivAt_integral_mul.{u_1} : ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
  (f : α → ℝ), Integrable f μ → ∀ (x₀ : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun x => ∫ (a : α), x * f a ∂μ) (∫ (a : α), f a ∂μ) x₀ :=
fun {α} [MeasurableSpace α] μ f hf x₀ =>
  have h :=
    hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le univ_mem
      (Eventually.of_forall fun x => Integrable.aestronglyMeasurable (Integrable.const_mul hf x))
      (Integrable.const_mul hf x₀) (Integrable.aestronglyMeasurable hf) (Eventually.of_forall fun x x_1 x_2 => le_rfl)
      (Integrable.norm hf)
      (Eventually.of_forall fun a x x_1 =>
        Eq.mp
          (HasDerivAt.congr_simp (fun y => id y * f a) (fun y => y * f a) (id (Eq.refl fun y => y * f a)) (1 * f a)
            (f a) (one_mul (f a)) x x (Eq.refl x))
          (HasDerivAt.mul_const (hasDerivAt_id x) (f a)));
  h.right
